tasks.title: Clarify deterministic query planning versus agent/task planning
scope: Align README and architecture/reference explanations with internal/planner bounded query algebra and kb.query.
Describe the exclusion of LLM reasoning and agent/task execution precisely.
non_goals: No query behavior, protocol, feature flag, or disabled-capability changes.
No agent runtime or documentation redesign.
acceptance: A reader can distinguish deterministic retrieval planning from excluded agent/task planning.
Every planning claim agrees with current CLI, MCP, planner tests, and product boundary.

tasks.title: Replace exactly-25 product restriction with a bounded variable estate
scope: Use a documented finite estate bound in catalog and mirror validation, with matching IDs and atomic bootstrap.
Update product docs and validation tests; retain the exactly-25 hermetic and private-estate acceptance benchmarks.
non_goals: No unbounded catalogs, connector sources, onboarding UI, or benchmark dilution.
acceptance: Valid estates of 1, several, 25, and the documented maximum pass matching catalog/registry validation.
Zero, over-limit, duplicate IDs, unknown entries, and catalog/registry mismatches fail clearly.
The 25-repository benchmark still uses 25 and both hermetic runs have equal fingerprints.
checks: Two fresh make acceptance-v1 runs; compare semantic_fingerprint

tasks.title: Persist a named knowledge instance with stable identity, optional logo and seed colour
scope: Persist validated instance metadata in owned durable state and expose it to the authenticated browser.
Retain identity across renaming, restarts, incremental ingest, and projection rebuilds; define migration defaults for existing data.
non_goals: No accounts, remote asset fetching, cloud sync, or changes to repository/entity identity.
No MCP mutations or executable/uploaded SVG content.
acceptance: A restart and projection rebuild preserve instance ID, name, optional logo, and seed colour.
Legacy data opens with safe migration/defaults; renaming never changes stable ID.
Malformed/oversized assets and colours are rejected; missing logo has an accessible fallback.
Authenticated UI displays saved values; canonical evidence remains independent of presentation metadata.
checks: Persistence/restart and legacy-data migration integration checks

tasks.title: Add first-run onboarding for mirrored repositories
scope: Wire a first-run flow into the live UI for configuring an approved bounded mirror estate and compiling immutable mirror snapshots.
Show truthful validation, sync, ingestion, progress, errors, and retry states using owned data.
non_goals: No direct local workspace indexing yet, credential collection, external connectors, or arbitrary command execution.
No write-capable MCP operations or bypassing browser security.
acceptance: A fresh instance can configure mirrors, sync and atomically bootstrap an approved estate, then reach evidence-backed querying.
Invalid/unsupported repositories fail visibly; interruption retains the last active generation and retry is safe.
Authenticated same-origin CSRF protection applies to every setup mutation; inputs cannot select arbitrary writable paths.
Source remotes/checkouts remain unchanged; browser flow is exercised through main.tsx and backend integration.
checks: Two fresh make acceptance-v1 runs; compare semantic_fingerprint
Authenticated first-run integration/E2E with fixture remotes

tasks.title: Add direct indexing through immutable snapshots of local Git workspaces
scope: Add an explicit approved local Git source route that captures immutable owned snapshots before compilation.
Define and document clean/dirty/untracked behavior, stable source identity, revision provenance, and failure/retry semantics.
non_goals: No indexing from mutable live roots, source writes, git reset/checkout/stash, filesystem watcher authority, or arbitrary non-Git folders.
No executing source hooks/build scripts, LLM reasoning, or connector adapters.
acceptance: Supported clean local workspaces index through immutable owned snapshots with commit and file-hash provenance.
Source status, tracked bytes, untracked bytes and permissions remain identical before/after success and failure.
Concurrent edits cannot publish mixed-source evidence; unsafe paths/symlinks and unsupported states fail explicitly.
Mirror ingestion and generation activation semantics remain intact; query results cite the captured source generation.
checks: Two fresh make acceptance-v1 runs; compare semantic_fingerprint
Source non-mutation and concurrent-edit snapshot integration tests

tasks.title: Complete Spotlight-first querying and truthful knowledge-cloud feedback
scope: Wire Spotlight-style keyboard-first querying and instance knowledge-cloud UI into the live authenticated entry point.
Display canonical evidence, active generations, coverage, bounded/truncated states, and truthful found/not_found/unknown feedback.
non_goals: No fabricated graph nodes, simulated indexing progress, vector-as-evidence, LLM chat/recommendations, or query API scope expansion.
No removing simpler accessible evidence navigation.
acceptance: Keyboard open/close, focus restoration, query submission, result selection and evidence navigation work in live main.tsx.
Empty, unsupported, stale, unavailable, unknown, not_found and truncated results have distinct truthful feedback.
Cloud nodes/edges and counts derive from active projection/evidence responses and show generation boundaries.
Browser security, bounded deterministic retrieval and accessibility survive UI integration.
checks: Two fresh make acceptance-v1 runs; compare semantic_fingerprint
Live authenticated UI E2E for keyboard focus and evidence/result-state cases

tasks.title: Verify macOS Apple Silicon installation and first-run experience
scope: Run native arm64 release/install/checksum and first-run mirrored/local onboarding, Spotlight queries, and evidence checks.
Verify pinned bundled Nomic runtime, permissions, interrupted setup/retry, restart identity, and document reproducible operator evidence.
non_goals: No claiming cross-compilation or Linux fixture success proves macOS UX.
No signing/notarization promises, new hosted services, or real-estate readiness without the private corpus.
acceptance: On actual macOS arm64, a clean install verifies checksums, launches securely, and completes first-run ingestion and evidence querying.
Brand identity persists through restart; local snapshots leave sources unchanged; bundled embeddings work without runtime downloads.
Two native acceptance runs are accepted with matching fingerprints; failures and remediation are documented.
If native hardware is unavailable, task remains blocked with an exact native checklist and handoff, never marked verified.

make harness-validate-web on native macOS arm64
make release VERSION=<reviewed-version> OUTPUT_DIR=<owned-directory>; verify archive checksum
